lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: JON, and then moss. The stone has been left a long time, the way you leave a letter you aren't ready to answer.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: Nobody has planted anything here in years. That, at least, I can fix.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: Blue by the kerb, daisies wherever the spell liked. He'd have corrected all of it.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: The moss is still on the name. Not tonight. Something small and household would do it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: JONAS BRENN. HE HUMMED WHEN HE WEEDED.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: Somebody carved that. Somebody who was there.

lines.speaker: char_freyja
lines.text: It's the first thing anyone's said about him that I could believe straight away.
